tickets.name: Early: Lions -3

legs.label: Lions -3 (-105), combined_edge +0.019
legs.game: Green Bay Packers at Detroit Lions
legs.why: Rule A. Pinnacle fair 53.1% at Lions -3 (-113) vs DK implied 51.2% at -105, so DK is 8 cents cheaper on the same number. Key number 3: this is the cheap side of it. If Lions money lifts DK to -3.5 or -115, the price we hold is gone. No injury news found (search returned no 2026 Week 7 reports), so the reason is the key number and expected public money on Detroit at home.

tickets.why: Rule A early ticket. Reason it moves against us: Lions -3 is the cheapest price at the key number, and home-favorite money pushes DK to -110 or -3.5 by Sunday. Own 52.5% vs 51.2% breakeven, Pin fair 53.1%. Reason is thin and unverified, the price is the larger part of the case.
tickets.kill_switch: Kill if DK is already Lions -3.5, or -3 at -115 or worse, when you go to place it. Kill if Goff is ruled out. If already placed, keep unless Goff is out.

tickets.name: Bears -3

legs.label: Bears -3 (-102), combined_edge -0.012
legs.game: New England Patriots at Chicago Bears
legs.why: Rule B. Pin fair on Bears -3 is 49.3%, DK implied 50.5%, my 51.5%, within 6 points of Pin. Patriots ruled out both starting guards (Vera-Tucker, Brown) and CB Davis, Canada, Prunty; Bears pass rush faces a patched line and Bears secondary is mostly intact. Pin has seen the same report, so the edge is thin and the price is only -102.

tickets.why: Core single. Own 51.5% vs 50.5% breakeven at -102. Thursday has one game, so the 30 percent game cap cannot apply; all $15 sits on Patriots-Bears by necessity. Profit Boost goes here if you hold the token (confirm in the Promos tab).
tickets.kill_switch: Kill if DK moves to Bears -3.5 or -3 at -115 or worse, or Caleb Williams is inactive. If placed, keep unless Williams is out; if out, no hedge, take the loss risk or cash out. Freed $10 goes to Under 50.5 single only if Williams is out.

legs.game: New England Patriots at Chicago Bears
legs.why: Rule B. Pin fair 59.3%, DK implied 60.8%. Own 61%, within 6 of Pin. Same Bears injury edge as the spread single, so this is the same view stacked.

legs.label: Under 50.5 (-102), combined_edge -0.017
legs.game: New England Patriots at Chicago Bears
legs.why: Rule B. Pin fair 48.8%, DK implied 50.5%. Own 50.5%. Two guards out and three corners out slows the Patriots offense and puts Maye under pressure; short week; no wind in the forecast so weather does not help the Under.
